text:
priyanka: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to rework the migrations guide and split examples into /docs/examples. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
sam: looked — nice cleanup. small link fix in the second example though, which is why preview failed.
priyanka: yeah the linkcheck action flagged it. I pushed a fix but wanted to ask about merge rules before unblocking: CODEOWNERS currently requires docs-team + eng approvals for anything under /docs/**. For content-only fixes that are trivial, can we avoid waiting for the eng reviewer? :thinking:
liam: FYI infra has been seeing a lot of noisy preview runs during business hours.
sam: +1. The real pain is the preview check (github action `docs-preview`) runs a full build and it sometimes times out and blocks auto-merge even when CI is green.
priyanka: my thought: add a label `docs-staged-merge` which signals the release-bot to queue the PR for the nightly docs merge window (02:00 UTC). That way previews are allowed to stabilise and we don't spam reviewers during day.
jen: I like queued merges. tiny suggestion — for trivial typo/link fixes, could the docs-bot auto-approve after `linkcheck` and `spellcheck` pass and a single docs reviewer approves? avoids waiting for eng.
liam: technically feasible. two parts: (1) relax CODEOWNERS enforcement for docs-only paths via a GH Action that posts a bypass approval, (2) have the release-bot respect the `docs-staged-merge` label and only attempt merges during the window.
priyanka: example CODEOWNERS fragment I was thinking of updating:
```
# keep eng on critical code, but allow docs-team to approve content-only
/docs/examples/ @redwood-docs
/docs/migrations/ @redwood-docs
/src/** @redwood-eng
```
sam: careful — we can’t just change CODEOWNERS to remove eng from /docs/* without policy signoff. But we can implement the GH Action approach that auto-approves the PR if file changes are limited to docs paths and checks pass.
ci-bot: ACTION: linkcheck passed for PR #482; spellcheck passed; build_snapshot succeeded. Preview build queued.
jen: If we go GH Action -> auto-approve for docs-only, we should also tag PR description with `#docs-bypass-policy` so audits are clear.
priyanka: agree. I'll draft a tiny GH Action that: checks changed files, runs lightweight checks (link/spell), then posts an approval comment and adds `docs-auto-approved` label. Then the release-bot will pick up labelled PRs and only merge during the nightly window.
liam: also add a safeguard: if the preview build fails or any non-docs path is touched, action should not auto-approve and must leave a comment explaining manual review required.
sam: sounds good. one more ask — can the release-bot bump the PR merge priority if a security-related docs change is detected? e.g., doc about TLS config.
priyanka: yes we can add keyword detection (`security`, `vuln`, `tls`, `auth`) to override staging and attempt an immediate merge if checks pass and eng approves.
jen: can you post the draft action in this thread when you have it? i can review wording and audit log text.
priyanka: will do. Thanks everyone — i'll open a follow-up PR in infra with the action + release-bot hook. tagging for visibility: @sam @liam @jen.
